description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Creates a posting queue. Once items are added it BOOKS REAL POSTS on the given platforms on its cadence (default daily 19:00 America/Chicago, 2 booked ahead). Use `startsAt` to hold everything until a date. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/queues.)

lookahead.description: How many upcoming items are scheduled at the platform at once.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 with an offset (or Z). Nothing is booked before it; the first slot is the first timeOfDay (in the queue's timezone) at or after it, so a startsAt that is itself a slot is the first slot. A past date holds nothing back.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Slots keep their local time across DST.

youtube.description: Queue-wide YouTube defaults (a draft's own options win; titles are per item). YouTube upload options, applied to YouTube targets only. madeForKids is always sent to YouTube (default false). A missing title is derived from the first sentence of the caption, cut to 100 characters at a word boundary. SCHEDULED UPLOADS: the video is uploaded ahead of scheduledAt. "public" is uploaded as private and released by YouTube at the scheduled time; "unlisted" is watchable by anyone with the link from upload time; "private" stays private.

categoryId.description: YouTube category id, e.g. "28" (Science & Technology). YouTube default: 22.

firstComment.description: For scheduled videos, posted at the scheduled time.

playlistId.description: From GET /api/v2/youtube/playlists for the same brand.

name: create_queue
title: Create a posting queue
